complete.problem: In scene s3, follow the energy as a worked example: electrical energy waits stored in the battery, then travels along the wire to the bulb, where electrical energy becomes light and heat. Each step is a change of state: the light lets us see and the heat rises into the air, so no energy has been used up.
complete.selfExplanation: Explain in one sentence how the electrical energy changes at the bulb, and why no energy has been used up.

steps.annotation: Energy kept waiting until it is needed: it sits stored in a battery or in fuel, ready to change into other forms.
steps.text: Step 1: In scene s3, follow the energy as a worked example: electrical energy waits stored in the battery, then travels along the wire to the bulb.

steps.annotation: Energy carried by electricity as it travels along wires: a battery supplies it and a bulb changes it into light and heat.
steps.text: Step 2: at the bulb, electrical energy becomes light and heat.

steps.annotation: A lamp or a toy runs out, so the energy feels consumed.
steps.text: Step 3: Each step is a change of state: the light lets us see and the heat rises into the air, so no energy has been used up.

faded.problem: In one sentence, say what really happens to energy when a toy car slows down and stops.
faded.selfExplanation: The first step is shown. Say where the energy goes next, and why none of it has been used up.

steps.annotation: The energy of something moving: a rolling car and a sliding ball carry movement energy.
steps.text: Step 1: the toy car's stored energy changes form as it slows down.

steps.annotation: Warm energy that moves from hot things to cooler places: it rises up from a cooking pot into the air.
steps.text: Step 2: the energy moves somewhere else, for example stored energy becoming heat.

steps.annotation: Energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else.
steps.text: Step 3: so the energy is transferred, never used up.

paired.problem: Name the five forms of energy shown at the start of the animation.
paired.solution: Light, heat, sound, movement and stored energy.
